reserves.name: Aggregate Solstice attested reserves
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Circle, Tether, and MakerDAO stablecoin issuers (USDC, USDT, and DAI per Solstice collateral disclosure)

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-6 (lead usx-solstice)
reserveReview.rationale: Solstice identifies USDC and USDT on its product page, while the USX FAQ documents USDC, USDT, and DAI as reserve-stablecoin options for the Liquid Stability Reserve. A 2026-07-20 fetch of the attestation dashboard returned only aggregate reserves/supply timeline values (collateralization about 1.004), not asset-level balances, so exact constituent weights cannot be authored defensibly. The slice name is aligned to the exact solstice-attestation adapter row identity so the reviewed classification overlays the captured aggregate exposure.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Solstice collateral disclosure and the aggregate reserve attestation timeline emitted by the solstice-attestation live adapter
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The USDC, USDT, and DAI constituent split is not published by the aggregate attestation source.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: USDC, USDT, and DAI are named as reserve stablecoins, but the aggregate attestation source does not establish their current individual weights.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Solstice publishes aggregate collateral coverage and names reserve stablecoins, but the public materials do not establish legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, rehypothecation terms, or current custody shares.
